(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (dist-from start)
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list start))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (bfs)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let* ((p (first queue)) (r (first p)) (c (second p)) (d0 (hash-ref dist p)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
              (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                           (not (= (at g nr nc) 5))
                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (list nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! dist (list nr nc) (+ d0 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc)))))))
            (bfs))))
      (bfs)
      dist)
    (define (ways-from start dist)
      (define ways (make-hash))
      (hash-set! ways start 1)
      (for ([p (in-list (sort (hash-keys dist) (lambda (a b) (< (hash-ref dist a) (hash-ref dist b)))))])
        (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
          (let ((n (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))
            (when (and (hash-has-key? dist n) (= (hash-ref dist n) (+ (hash-ref dist p) 1)))
              (hash-set! ways n (+ (hash-ref ways n 0) (hash-ref ways p 0)))))))
      ways)
    (define s (first (find-color g 2)))
    (define t (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define ds (dist-from s))
    (if (not (hash-has-key? ds t))
        g
        (let* ((dg (dist-from t))
               (ws (ways-from s ds))
               (wg (ways-from t dg))
               (best (hash-ref ds t))
               (total (hash-ref ws t)))
          (foldl (lambda (p out)
                   (if (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                            (hash-has-key? ds p)
                            (hash-has-key? dg p)
                            (= (+ (hash-ref ds p) (hash-ref dg p)) best)
                            (= (* (hash-ref ws p 0) (hash-ref wg p 0)) total))
                       (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8)
                       out))
                 g (grid-positions g))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (dist-from start)
      (define dist (make-hash))
      (define queue (list start))
      (hash-set! dist start 0)
      (define (bfs)
        (unless (empty? queue)
          (let* ((p (first queue)) (r (first p)) (c (second p)) (d0 (hash-ref dist p)))
            (set! queue (rest queue))

              (let ((nr (+ r (first d))) (nc (+ c (second d))))
                (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))

                           (not (hash-has-key? dist (list nr nc))))
                  (hash-set! dist (list nr nc) (+ d0 1))
                  (set! queue (append queue (list (list nr nc)))))))
            (bfs))))
      (bfs)
      dist)
    (define (ways-from start dist)
      (define ways (make-hash))
      (hash-set! ways start 1)
      (for ([p (in-list (sort (hash-keys dist)
                              (lambda (a b) (< (hash-ref dist a) (hash-ref dist b)))))])
        (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
          (let ((n (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))))
            (when (and (hash-has-key? dist n)
                       (= (hash-ref dist n) (+ (hash-ref dist p) 1)))
              (hash-set! ways n (+ (hash-ref ways n 0) (hash-ref ways p 0)))))))
      ways)
    (define (mandatory-cells start goal)
      (define ds (dist-from start))
      (if (not (hash-has-key? ds goal))
          '()
          (let* ((dg (dist-from goal))
                 (ws (ways-from start ds))
                 (wg (ways-from goal dg))
                 (best (hash-ref ds goal))
                 (total (hash-ref ws goal)))
            (filter (lambda (p)
                      (and (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                           (hash-has-key? ds p)
                           (hash-has-key? dg p)
                           (= (+ (hash-ref ds p) (hash-ref dg p)) best)
                           (= (* (hash-ref ws p 0) (hash-ref wg p 0)) total)))
                    (grid-positions g)))))
    (define s (first (find-color g 2)))
    (define t (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define ds (dist-from s))
    (if (not (hash-has-key? ds t))
        g
        (let* ((best (hash-ref ds t))
               (mandatory (mandatory-cells s t)))
          (if (empty? mandatory)
              g
              (let* ((gate
                       (first
                        (sort mandatory
                              (lambda (a b)
                                (let* ((da (hash-ref ds a))
                                       (db (hash-ref ds b))
                                       (ka (abs (- (* 2 da) best)))
                                       (kb (abs (- (* 2 db) best))))
                                  (cond
                                    [(< ka kb) #t]
                                    [(> ka kb) #f]
                                    [(> da db) #t]
                                    [(< da db) #f]
                                    [(< (first a) (first b)) #t]
                                    [(> (first a) (first b)) #f]
                                    [else (< (second a) (second b))]))))))
                     (suffix (mandatory-cells gate t)))
                (foldl (lambda (p out)
                         (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8))
                       g suffix)))))))
